Try every ability
Try this
What happens
Hold the FORWARD/BACK/LEFT/RIGHT buttons on the screen
the robot moves while your finger is on it and stops when you let go
Tap STOP on the screen
motors and sound stop, the mode returns to normal
Tap the robot's face
the screen shows the camera for 10 seconds (tap again to leave)
Tap SPEAK, then talk for 4 seconds
your voice is turned into text, answered by the AI, spoken aloud and sent to Telegram
Telegram: /status
distance, battery, temperature, humidity, tilt
